calls.description: ``N(0, I)`` latent codes, shape ``(n, latent_dim)``.

calls.title: lame parameters
calls.description: ``(lambda, mu)`` from Young's modulus ``E`` and Poisson's ratio ``nu`` (isotropic).

calls.title: winkler parabolic contact
calls.description: Closed form for a parabolic gap g = x² / (2R) on a Winkler layer of modulus k_w (MPa/mm), load F over a width b: p = k_w (δ - x²/2R) on |x| < a, a = sqrt(2 R δ), F = (4/3) b k_w a δ.

calls.title: constraint map
calls.description: Sparse map ``A = P a + A_D``: Dirichlet nodes take their values, a periodic slave node takes ``sign * A[master]`` (chains are resolved), the remaining nodes are the unknowns ``a``.

calls.title: illustrative steel
calls.description: Smooth saturating curve ``B = mu0 H + Js (2/pi) atan(pi (mu_r_init - 1) mu0 H / (2 Js))``.

calls.title: mesh from gmsh
calls.description: Convert the current gmsh model (already meshed) into a :class:`Mesh2D`.
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, ModuleNotFoundError No module named 'gmsh'

calls.title: rossby haurwitz speed
calls.description: Eastward angular phase speed of the Rossby-Haurwitz wave in the non-divergent barotropic model [rad/s] (Haurwitz 1940); the shallow-water wave moves slightly slower.

calls.title: stable dt
calls.description: Explicit RK4 time step: the fastest resolved wave is (sqrt(gh) + |u|) at wavenumber ~ N/a; RK4 is stable on the imaginary axis up to 2.8.

calls.title: viper
calls.description: VIPER at nominal ride height on level ground (wheels just touching with their grousers).

calls.title: actuator series
calls.description: Sample one excitation on ``n_steps`` uniform points of ``tau`` in ``[0, 1]``, scaled to ``[lo, hi]``.
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, KeyError ''

calls.title: rectangular section properties
calls.description: Returns (I, Q) for a rectangular cross-section: second moment of area I = b*h^3/12, first moment of area at the neutral axis Q = b*h^2/8 (used for shear stress).

calls.title: solve nonlinear beam static
calls.description: Load-stepped Newton-Raphson static solve of the geometrically nonlinear (Von Karman) Euler-Bernoulli beam, at the static limit of `NonlinearBeamNewmarkFEM` (see module docstring). `fiber_distance_m` is the distance from the neutral axis to the outer fiber used for bending-stress recovery (height/2 f
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, KeyError 'N'

calls.title: herschel bulkley stress
calls.description: tau = tau_y + K*gamma_dot**n. `gamma_dot` is floored at 1e-9 s^-1.

calls.title: non newtonian effective viscosity
calls.description: mu_eff = tau/gamma_dot = tau_y/gamma_dot + K*gamma_dot**(n-1).

calls.title: generalized reynolds number
calls.description: Re_gen = rho*|v|**(2-n)*D**n / (K*8**(n-1)); laminar if Re_gen < 2100.

calls.title: metzner reed friction factor
calls.description: f = 16/Re_gen (laminar, Re_gen < 2100) or 0.0791*Re_gen**-0.25 (turbulent, Blasius/Metzner-Reed).

calls.title: non newtonian pressure gradient
calls.description: dP/ds = rho*g*sin(inclination) + f*rho*v**2/(2*D_h). `inclination_rad` is measured from horizontal (pi/2 = vertical, the default).

calls.title: integrate pressure profile
calls.description: Steady-state 1D pressure integration along path length `s` in [0, length_m], by explicit forward Euler on `dP/ds` from `pressure_gradient`. `rho_profile`/`inclination_deg_profile` may be a constant or a callable `f(s_m) -> value`. `tvd_profile(s_m)` supplies true vertical depth for the equivalent-de

calls.title: build and hold profile
calls.description: Discretize the build-and-hold path into `bin_width_m`-wide bins (midpoint-evaluated) and integrate TVD/HD along it. `vertical_length_m = total_length_m - build_length_m - hold_length_m` is derived, not an independent input, so the three lengths are always consistent.
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, ValueError build_length_m (1.0) + hold_length_m (1.0) exceed total_length_m (1.0) -- vertical_length_m would be negative (-1.000)

calls.title: lame hoop stress outer
calls.description: sigma_theta at r=r_outer: 2*p_i*ri**2 / (ro**2-ri**2) (the general Lame hoop-stress formula's `(1 + ro**2/r**2)` factor evaluates to exactly 2 at r=r_outer -- see module docstring).

calls.title: lame hoop stress inner
calls.description: sigma_theta at r=r_inner (the maximum): p_i*(ri**2+ro**2) / (ro**2-ri**2).

calls.title: torsional shear stress
calls.description: tau = T*c/J, c = r_outer (maximum shear, at the outer fiber).

calls.title: bending stress from curvature
calls.description: sigma_bend = E*kappa*r_outer (outer-fiber bending stress for a circular cross-section bent to curvature `kappa` [1/length]).

calls.title: von mises triaxial
calls.description: Full triaxial Von Mises equivalent stress for three orthogonal principal-direction normal stresses plus a shear stress acting in the (axial, hoop) plane. See module docstring for the derivation and its biaxial (`sigma_radial=0`) reduction.

calls.title: beam column moment amplification factor
calls.description: AF = 1 / (1 - P/P_cr), the standard beam-column second-order (P-Delta) moment-amplification approximation (see module docstring). `P/P_cr` is clipped to `max_ratio` before dividing, since the approximation (and physically, the member) diverges as the axial load approaches the critical load -- the cl

calls.title: rotating bending stress cycle
calls.description: Von Mises stress envelope over one full rotation of a shaft/rod under constant axial + hoop + torsional stress plus a bending stress that varies as `sigma_bending_amplitude*cos(theta)` (see module docstring), and the alternating/mean stress a fatigue analysis needs from that envelope.

calls.title: stribeck friction torque
calls.description: T_friction = sign(omega)*[T_kinetic + (T_static-T_kinetic)*exp(-|omega|/omega_breakout)].

calls.title: sn curve cycles to failure
calls.description: N_f = 10**(A - m*log10(sigma_a)) for a fully-reversed amplitude `sigma_a` (floored at 1.0 to keep log10 finite).

calls.title: goodman equivalent amplitude
calls.description: Equivalent fully-reversed amplitude per the modified-Goodman line (see module docstring): sigma_alt / (1 - sigma_mean/S_ut). A mean stress approaching (or exceeding) S_ut drives this to infinity/ negative, correctly signaling the Goodman boundary has already been crossed by static overload alone.

calls.title: goodman safety ratio
calls.description: sigma_alt/S_e + sigma_mean/S_ut -- the Goodman-line safety ratio itself (< 1 inside the safe region, independent of any S-N life estimate); `S_e` is the endurance limit / target-life fully-reversed strength the diagram is drawn against.

calls.title: miners rule damage
calls.description: Goodman-corrected S-N life `N_f`, this-period damage `n_cycles/N_f`, and Miner's-rule cumulative damage (clipped to [0, 1]) combining it with `prior_damage_fraction`.

calls.title: evaluation order
calls.description: Topological sort by LHS symbol, DFS with cycle detection.

calls.title: evaluate
calls.description: Evaluates every definition in the given (topological) order, returning the full symbol -> value environment (leaves + every computed symbol).

calls.title: calibrate
calls.description: Bounded nonlinear least-squares calibration (Trust Region Reflective) of every parameter with `fit=True` against `measured_rows`'s target-symbol columns, re-evaluating the FULL equation system (not a linearization) at every trial parameter vector -- see module docstring's NUMERICAL METHOD.
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, ExplicitEquationError no parameters marked fit=True

calls.title: make map
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, ValueError psi0 must exceed psi_ref_bep for a physically decreasing head-flow curve

calls.title: incompressible mass flow
calls.description: Liquid-service sizing (no expansion factor / choking model beyond simple flashing checks are out of scope here) -- w = Cv_SI * sqrt(dP * rho).

calls.title: colebrook white f
calls.description: Darcy friction factor -- laminar closed form below Re=2300, else Colebrook-White, solved via Newton iteration on 1/sqrt(f).

calls.title: acid fraction
calls.description: Henderson-Hasselbalch: fraction of a monoprotic acid-base pair present in the PROTONATED (acid) form.

calls.title: base fraction
calls.description: Fraction present in the DEPROTONATED (base/conjugate-base) form -- exactly 1 - acid_fraction(pH, pKa).

calls.title: diprotic fractions
calls.description: Bjerrum fractions (alpha_H2A, alpha_HA, alpha_A) for a diprotic acid-base system (H2A / HA- / A2-), generalizing the carbonate system (H2CO3/HCO3-/CO3^2-) to any two-pKa diprotic pair.

calls.title: interpret
calls.description: Turn ``task`` into a workflow of ``catalog`` and its inputs (see the module docstring).
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, JSONDecodeError Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)

calls.title: parse quantity
calls.description: The number in ``text`` converted to ``unit`` ("4 cm" -> 40 for mm); None if there is no number.

calls.title: get adapter
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, KeyError "no adapter ''; known: ['cfdof', 'freecad', 'openfoam', 'paraview', 'verify', 'web']"

calls.title: example workflow
calls.description: Path of a committed example workflow (``examples/<name>/workflow.yaml``).
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, FileNotFoundError no example workflow ''; there are ['channel_obstacle']

calls.title: get task
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, KeyError "Unknown task_id=''. Available: [flow_obstacle_2d]"

calls.title: get backend
calls.check: needs input: with its defaults, KeyError "Unknown backend=''. Available: [deepxde, jax_pinn, physicsnemo_sym, pinneapple_models, pinneapple_native]"

calls.title: get backend
calls.description: Return the name of the currently active backend.

calls.title: jax available
calls.description: Return ``True`` if JAX can be imported.

calls.title: analyze completeness
calls.description: NaN/missing-value fraction per field, plus an overall completeness score.

calls.title: analyze distribution
calls.description: scipy.stats.describe per field (mean/variance/skewness/kurtosis).

calls.title: detect outliers
calls.description: IsolationForest fit jointly across all numeric fields (stacked as a feature matrix over points); report the fraction flagged as outliers.

calls.title: field range issues
calls.description: Generic per-field physical-range check, keyed by the field's literal name: {field_name: (lo, hi)}. Returns a list of human-readable issue strings (empty if everything is within bounds).

calls.title: build consistency prompt
calls.description: Build the text prompt asking a VLM to judge a clip's physical consistency against a stated governing-physics assumption.

calls.title: extract json
calls.description: Best-effort extraction of the first ``{...}`` JSON object found in a block of free-form generated text. Returns ``None`` (never raises) if no valid JSON object is present.

calls.title: parse curation response
calls.description: Parse one VLM generation into a :class:`CurationRecord`. Never raises: a response that fails to parse as JSON yields the fallback label at confidence 0.5, with an empty reason -- the honest signal that the model's output was unusable, not a guessed judgment.

calls.title: exported functions from layout
calls.description: Exported functions recorded by ``rea inspect-binary-layout`` (ELF): entries of the ``SHT_DYNSYM`` table that are defined, global/weak, default-visibility FUNC/GNU_IFUNC symbols.

calls.title: summarize js evidence
calls.description: Build a :class:`FeatureMap` from one ``analyze_javascript_application`` Evidence payload (the parsed JSON, not the path).

calls.title: sanitize
calls.description: Turn runs of Unicode super/subscript characters into reportlab ``<super>``/``<sub>`` markup.
